resources.name: Clementi atomic radial functions (Fe 3d, Cl 3s, Cl 3p, N 2s, N 2p)
resources.access: Published in Clementi E. Tables of atomic functions. IBM Corp. 1965. Available in standard quantum chemistry libraries.

resources.name: Molecular geometry of hemin chloride
resources.access: Crystal structure from Koenig (1965) or constructed from standard porphyrin coordinates: Fe in plane, Fe–N ≈ 2.07 Å, axial Fe–Cl ≈ 2.32 Å along z‑axis. Geometry details are publicly available.

resources.name: Extended Hückel parameters (ionisation potentials, Slater exponents for Fe, N, C, H, Cl)
resources.access: Standard parameters from Rettig et al. (1968) and Zerner & Gouterman (1966), available in the computational chemistry literature.
